structured_output.what_is_happening: A 9-day-old PumpSwap token (already migrated) that sat dormant suddenly did about 10x in the last hour (roughly $31k of volume, 107 unique buyers). The price has already dropped about 60% from its ATH ($0.000223, about $220k mcap) to about $0.0000906 ($87k mcap), and GeckoTerminal m5 is -6.9%. The token routes creator fees via UsePaid to the X handle @praxisnation, a real digital-nation/city project (Dryden Brown). The deployer is a serial launcher with 2,183 tokens.

narrative.description: Fee-routing token tied to Praxis, a real, well-known 'network state' and city project with fresh news about an AI city in Uruguay. No evidence that Praxis endorses, claimed or promoted the token.
narrative.why_spreading: Unknown trigger. Possibly speculation that Praxis will claim the fees or engage with the coin, or an organised group pump (bundlers, vanity wallets). No X posts found.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only PRAXIS token with liquidity and volume. Its fees are routed to @praxisnation, but it was deployed by a serial launcher (2,183 tokens), not by Praxis.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Two same-day PRAXIS tokens (9PRZ… 'PRAXIS Nation', G5qD…) are dead with about $2-3k mcap and zero volume.

authenticity.evidence: GMGN counts 598 bundler wallets and a 72% bot/degen rate. Top holders use vanity addresses (yours99, bribe99, sorry16, mwah94, truLy), which suggests one organised group. The spike came after 9 days of dormancy. There are 103 smart-wallet tags, but smart_money_signal_count is 0. No paid DexScreener boosts; flagged as a community takeover.
authenticity.uncertainty: No X data. I could not see whether Praxis acknowledged the token.

structural_risks: Already down about 60% from the ATH set this hour

structured_output.counterargument: Praxis has a large, online, crypto-adjacent audience (about 151k claimed citizens). If @praxisnation claims the UsePaid fees or posts about the coin, a $87k-mcap token with burned LP could re-run past its $220k ATH in hours.
unknowns: Whether Praxis knows about or endorses the token
Whether the vanity-wallet cluster is a coordinated group

source_coverage.notes: Contract search found nothing relevant. Found Praxis's own X posts and news about Praxis, but nothing about the token. The UsePaid page failed with an SSL error. Reddit, Telegram and Discord were not searched because of the time limit.

structured_output.thesis: A spike from dormancy on a serial-launcher fee-routing token that borrows a real brand. It already peaked at about 2.5x the current price and is fading. The structure is safe from an LP pull, but a clean +100% from here needs Praxis to engage, which is unverified. Below-average runner odds.
